paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +1.25% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+4.38%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-4.16%). Brent crude changed -12.87% to 90.27. Gold changed +3.66% to 4,084.8. Bitcoin changed -2.25% to 74,231.1484. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.864%, a relative move of -0.61%. Among the firms tracked, Gold Miners (ETF) (+15.55%) and Newmont (+14.73%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Monzo explores fundraising at £7.5bn valuation as private equity talks stall (FT Markets). Lender had shifted focus to talks with buyout groups after failing to clinch a £10bn takeover by Brazilian fintech Nubank Deals and capital markets: The index impact of SpaceX’s record-shattering IPO (FT Markets).
